const FLOOR=.08;
const station=(id,kind,x,z,ax,az,facing,surface=FLOOR)=>({id,kind,dock:[x,FLOOR,z],approach:[ax,FLOOR,az],facing,surface:kind==='bed'?FLOOR+.12:surface});
// All coordinates are world metres. The old horse/sheep paddock is untouched.
export const COW_YARD_LAYOUT=Object.freeze({
 polygon:[[-14,-15.2],[-2.1,-15.2],[-2.1,-7.8],[-14,-7.8]],
 footprint:[[-14,-15.2],[1.1,-15.2],[1.1,-7.55],[-14,-7.55]],
 gate:[-4.4,-2.1],floor:FLOOR,bed:[-8.9,-13.2,1],
 shelter:{x:[-12.1,-6.4],z:[-13.2,-12.8]},water:[-5.6,-10.4,.8,.7],
 fenceSegments:[[-14,-15.2,-2.1,-15.2],[-14,-15.2,-14,-7.8],[-14,-7.8,-4.4,-7.8],[-2.1,-15.2,-2.1,-7.8]],
 obstacles:[...[[-13.8,-11.45],[-10.8,-11.45],[-5.15,-11.45],[-10.35,-7.95],[-13.8,-7.95],[-10.95,-7.95],[-5.45,-7.95]].map(([x,z])=>[x,z,.065,.065]),...[-13.05,-10.55,-8.05,-5.55].map(x=>[x,-13.65,.0275,1.275]),[-12.4,-9.6,1.35,.0275],[-9.5,-15.1,4.5,.1],[-13.9,-11.5,.1,3.7],[-8.2,-8.05,2.7,.22],[-4.8,-10.4,.35,.8],[-4.35,-11.3,.035,1.9],[-2.25,-11.3,.035,1.9],[-1.85,-11.3,.25,.7],[.0,-11.3,1.1,.75]],
 robot:{entry:[-3.3,FLOOR,-9],dock:[-3.3,FLOOR,-11.3],exit:[-3.3,FLOOR,-14.2],turn:[-4.95,FLOOR,-14.2],clear:[-4.95,FLOOR,-12]},
 tank:[0,FLOOR,-11.3],
 stations:[station('cow-bed-1','bed',-11.8,-13.2,-11.8,-11.8,0),station('cow-bed-2','bed',-9.3,-13.2,-9.3,-11.8,0),station('cow-bed-3','bed',-6.8,-13.2,-6.8,-11.8,0),station('cow-bed-4','bed',-12.1,-10.7,-10.6,-10.7,Math.PI/2),station('cow-bed-5','bed',-12.1,-8.5,-10.5,-9,Math.PI/2),station('cow-feed-1','feed',-9.5,-9,-9.5,-10.3,0,.53),station('cow-feed-2','feed',-7.2,-9,-7.2,-10.3,0,.53),station('cow-drink','drink',-5.75,-10.4,-7.1,-10.4,Math.PI/2,.6),station('cow-robot','robot',-3.3,-11.3,-3.3,-9,Math.PI)],
});


function wideCowLayout(){
 const l=structuredClone(COW_YARD_LAYOUT),east=11.9;
 l.polygon=[[-14,-15.2],[9.8,-15.2],[9.8,-7.8],[-14,-7.8]];
 l.footprint=[[-14,-15.2],[13,-15.2],[13,-7.55],[-14,-7.55]];
 l.bed=[-3.8,-13.2,1];l.shelter.x=[-13.3,5.7];l.water[0]+=east;
 l.fenceSegments=[[-14,-15.2,9.8,-15.2],[-14,-15.2,-14,-7.8],[-14,-7.8,-4.4,-7.8],[-2.1,-7.8,9.8,-7.8],[9.8,-15.2,9.8,-7.8]];
 l.obstacles=[...[-13.8,-9.8,-5.8,-1.8,2.2,6.2].map(x=>[x,-11.45,.065,.065]),...[-10.95,-5.45].map(x=>[x,-7.95,.065,.065]),...[-13.8,-9.8,-5.8,-1.8,2.2,6.2].map(x=>[x,-13.65,.0275,1.275]),[-3.6,-15.1,10.3,.1],[-13.9,-11.5,.1,3.7],[-8.2,-8.05,2.7,.22],[-4.8+east,-10.4,.35,.8],[-4.35+east,-11.3,.035,1.9],[-2.25+east,-11.3,.035,1.9],[-1.85+east,-11.3,.25,.7],[east,-11.3,1.1,.75]];
 l.robot=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(l.robot).map(([k,p])=>[k,[p[0]+east,p[1],p[2]]]));l.tank[0]+=east;
 l.stations=[...[-11.8,-7.8,-3.8,.2,4.2].map((x,i)=>station('cow-bed-'+(i+1),'bed',x,-13.2,x,-11.8,0)),...l.stations.filter(s=>s.kind==='feed'),...l.stations.filter(s=>s.kind==='drink'||s.kind==='robot').map(s=>({...s,dock:[s.dock[0]+east,s.dock[1],s.dock[2]],approach:[s.approach[0]+east,s.approach[1],s.approach[2]]}))];
 return l;
}
export function cowYardLayout(north=0){
 if(!north)return COW_YARD_LAYOUT;
 const l=wideCowLayout(),p2=p=>[p[0],p[1]-north],p3=p=>[p[0],p[1],p[2]-north];
 l.polygon=l.polygon.map(p2);l.footprint=l.footprint.map(p2);l.bed[1]-=north;l.shelter.z=l.shelter.z.map(z=>z-north);l.water[1]-=north;
 // Keep four metres of open approach outside the south-facing entrance.
 // The existing site/placement guards also reserve this space on saved farms.
 l.access=[l.gate[0],l.gate[1],l.polygon[2][1],l.polygon[2][1]+4];
 l.fenceSegments=l.fenceSegments.map(([x,z,bx,bz])=>[x,z-north,bx,bz-north]);l.obstacles=l.obstacles.map(([x,z,w,d])=>[x,z-north,w,d]);
 l.robot=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(l.robot).map(([k,p])=>[k,p3(p)]));l.tank=p3(l.tank);
 l.stations=l.stations.map(s=>({...s,dock:p3(s.dock),approach:p3(s.approach)}));return l;
}
